texts.title: Practice
texts.info: Hone your skills with different attack strategies! Practice levels unlock as you upgrade your Town Hall.
texts.unlocks: Practice mode unlocks at Town Hall 4

steps.name: TH4_Giant_Giants1
steps.text: Deploy a <c54a0fe>Giant</c> to shield the <c54a0fe>Wall Breakers</c>.

steps.name: TH4_Giant_WallBreakers
steps.text: Quickly destroy Walls before the <c54a0fe>Giant</c> dies.

steps.name: TH4_Giant_Giants2
steps.text: Now deploy <c54a0fe>Giants</c> to destroy all defenses.

steps.name: TH4_Giant_Goblins
steps.text: After <cf70d16>Mortar</c> is destroyed, deploy <c54a0fe>Goblins</c> to help clean up.

steps.name: TH5_Loon_Loons1
steps.text: Deploy several <c54a0fe>Balloons</c> to overwhelm defenses. Your first priority is the <cf70d16>Air Defense</c>.

steps.name: TH5_Loon_Loons2
steps.text: Deploy multiple groups to minimize splash damage from traps and <cf70d16>Wizard Towers</c>.

steps.name: TH5_Loon_Loons3
steps.text: Focus on destroying defenses that attack air units first!

steps.name: TH5_Loon_Loons4
steps.text: Destroy the last <cf70d16>Archer Tower</c> with your remaining <c54a0fe>Balloons</c>.

steps.name: TH6_Giwiwa_Giant1
steps.text: Deploy a <c54a0fe>Giant</c> to shield the <c54a0fe>Wall Breakers</c>.

steps.name: TH6_Giwiwa_WallBreakers1
steps.text: Destroy the first layer of Walls before the <c54a0fe>Giant</c> dies.

steps.name: TH6_Giwiwa_Giant2
steps.text: Begin the main attack by deploying your <c54a0fe>Giants</c> first so that they protect your <c54a0fe>Wizards</c>!

steps.name: TH6_Giwiwa_Heal1
steps.text: Use a <cffe346>Heal Spell</c> to protect <c54a0fe>Giants</c> from the <cf70d16>Wizard Tower</c>!

steps.name: TH6_Giwiwa_Wizards1
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Wizards</c> while the defenses are distracted!

steps.name: TH6_Giwiwa_WallBreakers2
steps.text: After <cf70d16>Mortar</c> shots have landed, open up the second layer of Walls so your army can get to the <cf70d16>Town Hall</c>!

steps.name: TH6_Giwiwa_Wizards2
steps.text: The coast is clear! Deploy More <c54a0fe>Wizards</c>!

steps.name: TH6_Giwiwa_Heal2
steps.text: Use another <cffe346>Heal Spell</c> on your <c54a0fe>Giants</c> to get them back to health!

steps.name: TH7_Dragon_Info_AirSweeper
steps.text: Approach the base from behind the <cf70d16>Air Sweeper</c>.

steps.name: TH7_Dragon_Lightning
steps.text: Destroy one of the <cf70d16>Air Defenses</c> with <c38eaff>Lightning Spells</c>.

steps.name: TH7_Dragon_BarbarianKing
steps.text: Deploy <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c> to shield the <c54a0fe>Dragons</c> from <cf70d16>Archer Towers</c>.

steps.name: TH7_Dragon_Dragons1
steps.text: Deploy a <c54a0fe>Dragon</c> to clear each side of the base.

steps.name: TH7_Dragon_Dragons2
steps.text: Deploy one more <c54a0fe>Dragon</c> to clear the corner of the base. This will help direct the rest of your army towards the middle.

steps.name: TH7_Dragon_Dragons3
steps.text: Deploy the remaining <c54a0fe>Dragons</c>.

steps.name: TH7_Hog_BarbarianKing
steps.text: Deploy <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c> to deal with the enemy king or he will wreck your <c54a0fe>Hog Riders</c>.

steps.name: TH7_Hog_Wizards
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Wizards</c> to help your King!

steps.name: TH7_Hog_Hogs
steps.text: Deploy all <c54a0fe>Hog Riders</c> to start their attack.

steps.name: KingHealthLow
steps.text: <c9916c8>Barbarian King's</c> hitpoints are dropping. Activate his ability!

steps.name: TH7_Hog_Heal1
steps.text: <c54a0fe>Hog Riders</c> have lost a lot of hit points. Use a <cffe346>Heal Spell</c> now!

steps.name: TH7_Hog_Heal2
steps.text: Use the remaining <cffe346>Heal Spells</c> to keep <c54a0fe>Hog Riders</c> alive while they clean up the base.

steps.name: TH7_Minion_Info_AirSweeper
steps.text: Approach the base from behind the <cf70d16>Air Sweeper</c>.

steps.name: TH7_Minion_Balloons
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Balloons</c> to destroy all <cf70d16>Air Defenses</c>.

steps.name: TH7_Minion_Rage1
steps.text: Use a <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c> to make <c54a0fe>Balloons</c> faster and deadlier!

steps.name: TH7_Minion_BarbarianKing
steps.text: Deploy <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c> to distract the <cf70d16>Wizard Tower</c>.

steps.name: TH7_Minion_Minions
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Minions</c> to take out the <cf70d16>Wizard Tower</c> and help with clean up.

steps.name: TH7_Minion_Rage2
steps.text: <c54a0fe>Minions</c> will make short work of their targets with the help of a <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c>.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_Earthquake
steps.text: Use an <ca9561f>Earthquake Spell</c> to weaken clustered defensive buildings and Walls.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_Funnel_Pekkas
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>2 P.E.K.K.As</c> to clear the sides of the village.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_Wizards1
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Wizards</c> for support.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_Golem
steps.text: Your <c54a0fe>Golem</c> has a lot of hitpoints. Deploy it ahead the other troops to shield them.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_WallBreakers
steps.text: Use <c54a0fe>Wall Breakers</c> to destroy the Wall while defenses are targeting your other troops.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_BarbarianKing
steps.text: Deploy <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c>. Since the sides have been cleared, he will head to the middle.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_Support_Pekkas
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>P.E.K.K.As</c>. They will now also head for the middle.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_Wizards2
steps.text: Deploy more support <c54a0fe>Wizards</c> to help your <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c> and <c54a0fe>P.E.K.K.As</c>.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_Heal1
steps.text: Use <cffe346>Heal Spell</c> on the entrance as all your troops walk through it.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_Rage
steps.text: Use <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c> on the entrance so that most troops will benefit from it.

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_Heal2
steps.text: Keep your <c54a0fe>Wizards</c> alive by using a <cffe346>Heal Spell</c> on them!

steps.name: TH8_Gowipe_Clean_Up
steps.text: Deploy remaining troops to help with clean up.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_BarbarianKing_1
steps.text: The <cf70d16>Enemy Queen</c> is a deadly opponent for your <c54a0fe>Balloons</c>. Deal with her first.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_BarbarianKing_2
steps.text: Deploy your <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c> to tackle her once she jumps outside the Walls.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_BarbarianKing_3
steps.text: Deploy your <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c> to tackle her once she jumps outside the Walls.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_KingAbility
steps.text: Use <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c> ability right away to quickly knock out the enemy <cf70d16>Queen</c>.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_ArcherQueen
steps.text: Deploy your <c9916c8>Archer Queen</c> to get rid of <cf70d16>Wizard Tower</c>, <cf70d16>Air Defense</c> and <cf70d16>Archer Tower</c>.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_Haste1
steps.text: Use <cf07bf8>Haste Spells</c> to speed up slow air units and reach the <cf70d16>Air Sweeper</c> quickly.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_Hounds
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Lava Hounds</c> to shield your <c3e8cb8>Balloons</c> and to trigger traps within the base.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_Balloons
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Balloons</c> behind the <c54a0fe>Lava Hounds</c>.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_Freeze
steps.text: Use <c38eaff>Freeze Spell</c> to disable the <cf70d16>Air Sweeper</c> while your troops approach.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_Rage1
steps.text: Use <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c> in position which benefits most of the troops.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_Rage2
steps.text: Use another <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c> to clear the remaining <cf70d16>Air Defenses and Air Sweeper</c>.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_Haste2
steps.text: Use another <cf07bf8>Haste Spell</c> to speed up your <c54a0fe>Balloons</c>.

steps.name: TH9_Lavaloon_CleanUp
steps.text: Deploy remaining troops and spells to clean up the base.

steps.name: TH9_Witch_FunnelWizard
steps.text: Deploy a <c54a0fe>Wizard</c> to clear the Army Camp.

steps.name: TH9_Witch_ArcherQueen
steps.text: Now deploy the <c9916c8>Archer Queen</c>. With the Army Camp gone, she will walk clockwise around the base.

steps.name: TH9_Witch_Healers
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Healers</c> to support the <c9916c8>Archer Queen</c>.

steps.name: TH9_Witch_Earthquake
steps.text: Four <ca9561f>Earthquake Spells</c> always destroy Walls. Use them to open up the base!

steps.name: TH9_Witch_Golems
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Golems</c> to charge into the base. They will soak most of the incoming damage.

steps.name: TH9_Witch_Witches1
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Witches</c> to clear buildings from the corner.

steps.name: TH9_Witch_Witches2
steps.text: Deploy most of the <c54a0fe>Witches</c> to support <c54a0fe>Golems</c>.

steps.name: TH9_Witch_BarbarianKing
steps.text: Deploy the <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c>.

steps.name: TH9_Witch_Rage
steps.text: Use <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c> on the entrance so that most troops will benefit from it.

steps.name: TH9_Witch_Poison
steps.text: Use <ce98714>Poison Spell</c> to slow down <cf70d16>Enemy Queen</c>.

steps.name: TH9_Witch_Jump
steps.text: Use <c85ff3b>Jump Spell</c> to reach closed compartments!

steps.name: TH9_Witch_Wizard
steps.text: Deploy remaining <c54a0fe>Wizard</c> to help clean up remaining buildings.

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_ArcherQueen
steps.text: Deploy <c9916c8>Archer Queen</c> to destroy two <cf70d16>Wizard Towers</c> to help protect your <c54a0fe>Bats</c> later on.

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_Healers
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Healers</c> to support the <c9916c8>Archer Queen</c>.

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_Rage1
steps.text: Use <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c> to boost your <c9916c8>Archer Queen</c> and <c54a0fe>Wall Breakers</c>.

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_WallBreakers
steps.text: Break the Wall to reach <cf70d16>Wizard Tower</c>. <c54a0fe>Wall Breakers</c> deal more damage to Walls if they are under <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c>!

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_WallWrecker
steps.text: Use remaining Troops to clear remaining <cf70d16>Wizard Towers</c> and <cf70d16>Multi Inferno Tower</c>. Start with <c54a0fe>Wall Wrecker</c>.

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_BarbarianKing
steps.text: Deploy the <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c>.

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_PEKKAs
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>P.E.K.K.As</c> to clear the way.

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_Bowlers
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Bowlers</c> to support the attack.

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_Rage2
steps.text: Use <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c> on the entrance so that most troops will benefit from it.

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_Batwave
steps.text: Use <c9916c8>Bat Spells</c> to create a huge swarm of <c54a0fe>Bats</c> which quickly clears remaining defenses.

steps.name: TH10_Bobat_Freezes
steps.text: Use <c38eaff>Freeze Spell</c> on any air-targeting defenses to help the <c54a0fe>Bats</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_FunnelEdrag1
steps.text: This base has severe weakness against <c54a0fe>Electro Dragons</c>. Deploy one to destroy <cf70d16>Air Defense</c> with chain lightning.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_ArcherQueen
steps.text: Deploy <c9916c8>Archer Queen</c> to complete the funnel.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_BattleBlimp
steps.text: Use <c54a0fe>Battle Blimp</c> to send <c54a0fe>Electro Dragon</c> to the core to destroy <cf70d16>Eagle Artillery</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_Rage1
steps.text: Use <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c> to increase power of the attack.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_Clones
steps.text: Use <ca0c0fe>Clone Spells</c> to create more <c54a0fe>Balloons</c> in the core.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_Deploy_Blimp
steps.text: Activate <c54a0fe>Battle Blimp</c> to deploy the Clan Castle troops which are inside.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_FunnelEdrag2
steps.text: Deploy one <c54a0fe>Electro Dragon</c> to clear the corner.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_Edrags
steps.text: Deploy remaining <c54a0fe>Electro Dragons</c> in a line.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_GrandWarden
steps.text: Deploy <c9916c8>Grand Warden</c> to support <c54a0fe>Electro Dragons</c>. Remember to use air mode to avoid any ground traps!

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_Balloons
steps.text: Finally, deploy the <c54a0fe>Balloons</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_BarbarianKing
steps.text: Deploy the <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_Rage2
steps.text: Using <cf07bf8>Rage Spells</c> will help you take down tough targets.

steps.name: WardenAbility
steps.text: Activate your <c9916c8>Grand Warden Ability</c> to protect your troops when they need it!

steps.name: TH11_Edrag_Clean_Up
steps.text: Use remaining spells to help with the clean up.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Info_Eagle
steps.text: Start the attack by destroying <cf70d16>Eagle Artillery</c> before it starts shooting.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Info_Queen
steps.text: You also need a plan to deal with <cf70d16>Enemy Queen</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Jump
steps.text: Use <c85ff3b>Jump Spell</c> so your <c9916c8>Archer Queen</c> can reach the targets!

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_IceGolem
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Ice Golem</c> to freeze most defensive buildings when it dies.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_BarbarianKing
steps.text: Deploy <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_ArcherQueen
steps.text: Deploy <c9916c8>Archer Queen</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_KingAbility
steps.text: Activate <c9916c8>Barbarian King Ability</c> before he dies.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Poison
steps.text: Use <ce98714>Poison Spell</c> to slow down <cf70d16>Enemy Queen</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Haste1
steps.text: Balloons are slow. Use <cf07bf8>Haste Spells</c> to make them fast! Try to use multiple fingers.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Hounds1
steps.text: Start with <c54a0fe>Lava Hounds</c> to shield your <c54a0fe>Balloons</c>!

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Balloons1
steps.text: Deploy most of the <c54a0fe>Balloons</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_GrandWarden
steps.text: Now deploy your <c9916c8>Grand Warden</c>. Use flight mode!

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_StoneSlammer
steps.text: Deploy the <c54a0fe>Stone Slammer</c>. It protects your <c54a0fe>Balloons</c> and destroys defenses!

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Balloons2
steps.text: Deploy some <c54a0fe>Balloons</c> to clear the area quickly.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Hounds2
steps.text: Deploy one more <c54a0fe>Lava Hound</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Balloons3
steps.text: Deploy the remaining <c54a0fe>Balloons</c>.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Rage
steps.text: Using <cf07bf8>Rage Spells</c> will help you take down tough targets.

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_WardenAbility
steps.text: Use your <c9916c8>Grand Warden's</c> ability to make your <c54a0fe>Balloons</c> invulnerable!

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Haste2
steps.text: Use your remaining <cf07bf8>Haste Spell</c> to help your <c54a0fe>Balloons</c> clean up!

steps.name: TH11_Lavaloon_Minions
steps.text: Use your <c54a0fe>Minions</c> to clean up what's left!

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_Balloon1
steps.text: <c54a0fe>Balloons</c> are great for clearing out traps that could hurt your <c54a0fe>Healers</c>. Deploy one now!

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_Healers
steps.text: To start a Queen Walk, deploy your <c54a0fe>Healers</c> in the corner.

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_ArcherQueen
steps.text: Deploy your <c9916c8>Archer Queen</c> in front of your <c54a0fe>Healers</c>.

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_Rage1
steps.text: Use a <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c> to put your <c54a0fe>Healers</c> into overdrive.

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_Giants
steps.text: Deploy <c54a0fe>Giants</c> in the middle and bottom.

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_WallWrecker
steps.text: Follow up with <c54a0fe>Wall Wrecker</c>, <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c> and <c9916c8>Grand Warden</c>.

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_GrandWarden
steps.text: Follow up with <c54a0fe>Wall Wrecker</c>, <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c> and <c9916c8>Grand Warden</c>.

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_BarbarianKing
steps.text: Follow up with <c54a0fe>Wall Wrecker</c>, <c9916c8>Barbarian King</c> and <c9916c8>Grand Warden</c>.

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_Witches
steps.text: <c54a0fe>Witches</c> provide cover for your other troops. Deploy them with your main group.

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_Bowlers
steps.text: <c54a0fe>Bowlers</c> are your main damage dealers. Deploy them middle and bottom!

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_WallBreakers
steps.text: Use <c54a0fe>Wall Breakers</c> at the bottom to open up an avenue for your <c54a0fe>Bowlers</c>!

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_Freeze1
steps.text: Use <c38eaff>Freeze Spell</c> on the <cf70d16>Inferno Tower</c> before it takes out your <c54a0fe>Wall Wrecker</c>!

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_Freeze2
steps.text: Now use <c38eaff>Freeze Spell</c> on the second <cf70d16>Inferno Tower</c>!

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_Rage2
steps.text: Use <cf07bf8>Rage Spell</c> to help your army to push through the middle and bottom!

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_Jump
steps.text: Use <c85ff3b>Jump Spell</c> to reach closed compartments!

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_KingAbility
steps.text: <c9916c8>Barbarian King's</c> hitpoints are dropping. Activate his <c9916c8>Ability</c>!

steps.name: WardenAbility
steps.text: Activate your <c9916c8>Grand Warden Ability</c> to protect your troops when they need it!

steps.name: TH12_Bowigi_CleanUp
steps.text: Deploy the remaining troops to help with the clean up.
